title: Silence, established practice, and negative options
shortTitle: Silence, established practice, and negative options
summary: The silence materials require attention to the relationship preceding the apparent offer.
notes: Hobbs and American Bronze involve patterns that make silence or continuing production meaningful. Unsolicited goods differ from an arrangement the recipient already authorized. The statutes described in the notes and the history of particular practices are reproduced as casebook material, not a current regulatory survey.
